# Starr Journey
> A casual web game about Starr dodging obstacles, built with KAPLAY
Made by KelvinY.

## How to Play
1. Drag your mouse or swipe your thumb to control Starr
2. Dodge obstacles, collect coins, and try to go as far as you can
3. That's it!
